title: Proximity and listing search
prompt: Design the search behind a map of places: users look at an area on the map and see the listings in it that match their filters.
hard_part: Geographic queries plus filters at scale
key_points: Indexed location (geohash or S2 cells, a quadtree, or the search engine's geo index) and explained the query
Fed a denormalized search index from the source of truth through change events, eventually consistent
Had a plan for date availability in search (in-document bitmap, post-filtering the top candidates, or precomputing)
Handled density skew: return the top N, cluster results server-side for map views
Chose how to shard the index (by ID with scatter-gather, or by geography) and named the trade-off
Cached common queries with canonical keys, or explained what changes for moving objects (in-memory grid, expiring updates)
